about: The Preface of the Blessed Virgin Mary with the formula “Nativitáte.” It praises Mary’s virginal motherhood and the eternal Light given to the world in Jesus Christ.

seg.nr: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

seg.tr: Truly it is right and just, fitting and leading to salvation, that we should give You thanks always and everywhere:

a.g: always and everywhere give thanks to You

seg.tr: O Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God:
And that in the Nativity of the Blessed Mary ever-Virgin we should praise, bless, and proclaim You.
She conceived Your only-begotten Son by the overshadowing of the Holy Spirit and, the glory of her virginity abiding, brought forth to the world the eternal Light, Jesus Christ our Lord.

a.g: by the overshadowing of the Holy Spirit
the glory of her virginity abiding

seg.tr: Through Him the Angels praise Your majesty, the Dominions adore it, and the Powers tremble before it.
The heavens, the heavenly Virtues, and the blessed Seraphim join in joyful celebration of Your majesty.

a.g: and the Virtues of the heavens

seg.tr: We beseech You to admit our voices to join theirs as we speak in humble confession:

a.g: We pray that You command our voices also to be admitted with them
